versions.changelog:
OpenClaw Context Optimizer 1.0.0 – initial release

- Reduces context/token usage by 40-60% via intelligent compression strategies (deduplication, pruning, summarization, hybrid).
- Integrates with OpenClaw Memory System for adaptive learning and long-term efficiency gains.
- Offers both Free (100 compressions/day) and Pro (unlimited, advanced analytics, priority, for 0.5 USDT/month) tiers.
- Provides ROI tracking, dashboard web UI, and local-only data storage for privacy.
- Supports Node.js 18+, OpenClaw v2026.1.30+, and x402 agent payments.
